description: Cross-reference one concept across EU and global authority id-spaces as aligned facets. Resolves the term to its concept anchor and emits a uniform list of facets: identifier CURIEs and language-tagged rendering literals ("label"@lang), each keyed by the shared concept, carrying one align verdict: exact (cited at its authority origin), frontier (no attested edge), or unresolved (transient outage, not 'no edge'). An exact identifier facet carries an IRI where its authority publishes one.

term.description: Concept to cross-reference (any EU language), e.g. 'personal data', 'henkilötieto'

name: concept_crosswalk
title: Concept cross-reference across EU/global authority id-spaces
